source_note: 사용자 제공 Penpot 원안; 공유 링크 비공개
method: Direct unauthenticated retrieval of user-supplied Penpot shared file, Transit decoding of all objects, inspection of text and click destinations, browser rendering of all 17 frames at original 390x844 dimensions. This is evidence-based expert inspection, not participant usability testing.

findings.issue: Vehicle identity and odometer change between garage and detail.
findings.recommendation: One canonical selectedVehicleId and shared vehicle entity across every surface; immutable vehicle binding on trip creation.
findings.acceptance: Select each powertrain and assert same name/odometer on garage, maintenance and trip.

findings.issue: Same tab changes name and destination.
findings.evidence: Garage 일정 navigates directly to calendar; detail 이동 계획 navigates to start-trip options.
findings.recommendation: Use consistent 차량 / 일정 / 설정 tabs with identical destinations and active-state treatment.
findings.acceptance: Each tab lands at same root from every screen; back returns previous context.

findings.issue: Source tab text is the click target with only 18px height.
findings.evidence: 27 bottom-tab text shapes have 18px height and click interaction. Many action text layers duplicate button interactions, so global small-layer count must not be presented as distinct button count.
findings.recommendation: Full tab hit regions >=48px; labels plus icons and accessible selected state.
findings.acceptance: Keyboard and touch can activate full tab area; active state does not rely only on blue text.

findings.issue: Login and signup are navigation-only, with no validation or real identity boundary.
findings.evidence: Footer explicitly says mock login; Google/login simply navigate to fixed garage. Input shapes have no behavior.
findings.recommendation: Offer explicit guest/local use; keep real provider login behind actual configuration. Inline errors, password visibility, keyboard types, loading feedback for any connected auth.
findings.acceptance: No claim that a provider account was authenticated when no authentication happened. Empty/invalid inputs cannot silently pass.

findings.issue: Vehicle registration cannot preserve actual input or model 0/1/2/3 vehicles.
findings.evidence: Save always navigates to fixed one-car garage; source cap is 3; no edit/delete route.
findings.recommendation: Persist vehicles, validate name/model/year/odometer, enforce cap in reducer and UI, provide edit/remove with confirmation, contextual empty state.
findings.acceptance: Create ICE/HYB/EV up to 3, reject fourth, persist after reload, remove active vehicle safely and resolve selection.

findings.issue: Swipe discoverability without actual interaction and weak selected context.
findings.evidence: Arrows and swipe instruction exist but arrow shapes have no prototype interactions.
findings.recommendation: Visible named vehicle chips or selector plus arrows, accessible selection, keep selected car visible above actions.
findings.acceptance: Changing vehicle changes every maintenance/trip action and never silently switches on navigation.

findings.issue: Maintenance urgency is generic and lacks the baseline that makes remaining distance meaningful.
findings.evidence: All detail statuses say 확인, while overview claims exact 750/250/etc km remaining; no last-service record.
findings.recommendation: Sort by overdue/due soon/healthy/unknown. Display last-service distance/date and user-adjustable interval. Allow recording service and notes. Without baseline show 기록 필요.
findings.acceptance: Overdue uses negative remaining distance correctly; service update recalculates due distance; unknown never appears healthy.

findings.evidence: ICE/HYB have oil and engine air filter; EV replaces engine-specific items with manufacturer-guided cooling inspection.
findings.recommendation: Centralized powertrain-dependent catalog; retain common tires/brakes/cabin filter/wipers; avoid invented universal EV cooling interval.
findings.acceptance: EV never shows engine oil or engine air filter; ICE/HYB do.

findings.issue: Calendar selection is a single static event without empty, denied, stale or missing-location paths.
findings.evidence: Only 오늘 15:00 강남 미팅 at 강남역; 일정 변경 has no click wiring.
findings.recommendation: Use real local event CRUD and optional calendar permission/import; clearly identify example events. Select upcoming dated events and allow manual destination if absent.
findings.acceptance: No events has useful CTA; past times handled explicitly; selecting event updates arrival target and destination.

findings.issue: Departure arithmetic is static and depends on two inaccessible settings.
findings.evidence: 15:00−80−10−10=13:20. Buffer slider and walking time have no interaction.
findings.recommendation: Compute from scheduled date+time, travel estimate, walk and buffer; expose controls and retain values; handle previous-day departure.
findings.acceptance: 15:00 with 80/10/10→13:20; 00:30 with 50/10/10→previous day 23:20; updated settings recalculate.

findings.issue: Map and route inputs are placeholders and may imply precision.
findings.evidence: Direct screen says actual MapLibre goes here. Preview is a raster map with example 18.2km/80min route, and claims shortest path.
findings.recommendation: Real labeled route controls, explicit preview estimates, fallback distance/time input if provider unavailable, external navigation handoff. Do not call a drawn line a computed shortest route.
findings.acceptance: Empty/same origin and destination rejected. Route-service failure remains usable and visibly estimated. Map interactions do what they advertise.

findings.issue: Route preview and saved travel distance are easy to confuse.
findings.evidence: Both screens prominently show route 18.2km while active recording also shows GPS example 1.24km.
findings.recommendation: Make current measured distance and elapsed time primary during recording; keep route estimate secondary and labeled. Save only confirmed measured or explicitly manual distance.
findings.acceptance: Starting a trip does not add full route estimate to odometer. Completing adds once to bound vehicle.

findings.evidence: Start simply navigates to active raster; finish simply navigates to one-car garage. Back discards recording context.
findings.recommendation: Finite state for idle/recording/paused/completed; permission-aware foreground GPS; persist recoverable active trip; explicit finish/save/discard; disable repeat saves.
findings.acceptance: Denied permission gives manual alternative; app background stops counting; invalid GPS points rejected; reload restores recoverable state; double finish cannot duplicate.

findings.issue: Background detection promise conflicts with foreground-only measurement statement.
findings.evidence: Settings shows enabled 백그라운드 주행 감지 at 30km/h; active screen says distance measured only while app is open.
findings.recommendation: Only expose capabilities actually implemented. Foreground-only limitation and permission status should be clear before recording. Never imply automatic background capture.
findings.acceptance: Unavailable detection is clearly disabled/explained; actual start still requires user confirmation.

findings.issue: Notification decisions are static and unreachable from main navigation.
findings.evidence: Inbox contains detection/leave-now examples; no other frame interaction points to notification frame; 아니요 returns garage without state.
findings.recommendation: Accessible inbox entry, readable/unread/dismiss states, context-aware route action, real scheduling only after permission with success/failure feedback.
findings.acceptance: Opening inbox is possible in app; dismiss persists; plan link resolves corresponding event; denied permission never displays scheduled success.

findings.issue: Dense small typography and fixed-height composition risk clipping with real data or font scaling.
findings.evidence: Source uses 390x844 fixed frames and many 10–14px text nodes, including 11px bottom labels.
findings.recommendation: Scrollable content, safe-area padding, font scaling, readable minimum body sizes, full-width 48–52px controls and persistent primary action that does not cover content.
findings.acceptance: 320px width, desktop web, long Korean car name, large text, soft keyboard all keep primary tasks reachable.

findings.issue: No durable state, records/history, or error recovery is specified.
findings.evidence: Prototype actions are exclusively navigate destinations; no service history or completed-trip view exists.
findings.recommendation: Versioned local persistence, validation on hydrate, visible save feedback, trip and service history, recoverable storage failures.
findings.acceptance: Refresh preserves vehicles/settings/logs; malformed storage recovers gracefully; no loss of existing records on partial update.

map.png.note: Raster only; includes third-party attribution in original composed frame, and cannot supply live map behavior.
